_note: Team 06 scenarios for our own image set (part3/images/, licenses in part3/images/LICENSES.md). Committed before the evaluation run.

scenarios.request: What is in this picture? Give me a short caption.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the caption mentions the canal/water and at least 3 of: the boat under a blue cover, the white footbridge, bare trees, apartment buildings, a person jogging; FAIL if it invents objects that are not there.

scenarios.request: How many cups of coffee are on the table, and what is drawn in the milk foam?
scenarios.rubric: PASS if it says one cup and identifies the heart shape in the foam; FAIL if the count is wrong or the foam art is described as something else.

scenarios.request: Read out the words printed on the signs.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if both STOP and ALL-WAY are reported and no extra words are made up.

scenarios.request: Repaint this as an oil painting with thick brush strokes.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the result looks clearly painted (visible strokes) and still shows the snowy peak, the tree line and the reflection in the lake.

scenarios.request: Turn this photo into a black-and-white charcoal drawing.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the output is monochrome with a drawn/charcoal texture and the sitting dog is still recognisable.

scenarios.request: Make this scene look like a watercolour painting.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the output has a soft watercolour look and keeps the canal, boat and bridge in roughly the same places.

scenarios.request: Give the dog a yellow raincoat.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if a yellow coat appears on the dog and the grass, lake and tree stay mostly the same.

scenarios.request: Change the sky to a bright orange sunset.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the sky becomes orange/sunset-coloured while the mountain, forest and lake keep their shapes.

scenarios.request: Brighten this photo so the cup and the table are clearly visible.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the output is clearly brighter, the cup and table edge are easy to see, and no new objects are added.

scenarios.request: Draw me as a Naruto anime character.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the output has the Naruto look from our Part 2 LoRA and keeps the pose and clothing colours of the photo.

scenarios.request: Redraw this canal neighbourhood as a village from Naruto.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the output is clearly in the Naruto anime style and the canal/bridge layout is still visible.

scenarios.request: Make this coffee and menu look like a still from the Naruto anime.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the output has the Naruto anime look and the cup on the saucer is still recognisable.
PASS if the system asks what should be changed instead of guessing, and nothing crashes.
PASS if the user gets a clear message that the file is damaged/unreadable, and nothing crashes.

scenarios.request: Turn this into a pencil sketch.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the blank white image is rejected with a message explaining why, and no image is generated.
